info.title: Almacen API
info.description: API para administrar el almacen. Salvo el login, las rutas piden un token Bearer de Sanctum.

post.summary: Log in and receive an access token
post.description: Public. Returns a Sanctum bearer token and the user with their role.
Requires a valid bearer token. Any authenticated user can log out.
Permission: permissions.create. The name uses the form resource.action, for example items.view.
Permission: roles.create. permission_ids assigns the permissions.

put.description: Permission: roles.update. permission_ids replaces the role permissions.

delete.description: Permission: roles.delete. Fails with 409 if the role still has users.
Permission: users.delete. Fails with 409 if the user is the current session or has movements.

Unauthenticated.description: Falta el token o no es valido.

Forbidden.description: El rol no tiene el permiso de esta accion.

ValidationError.description: Los datos no cumplen las reglas.

Conflict.description: El registro no se puede borrar.
